blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate committee on ethics and privileges has deemed the complaint against Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa over his prolonged absence sufficient in form and substance. In a notice, the committee said the complaint, including its supplemental submissions, substantially complied with the requirements set under Section 17 of its rules. “The Committee took up the matter at its Executive Session held on October 22, 2026 and pursuant to Sec. 18 of the Rules of the Senate Committee on Ethics and Privileges, found the complaint, as supplemented, in substantial compliance, both in form and in substance, with Section 17,” […]...
